title: Releasing: from merged PR to signed artifact

content.summary: A merged PR reaches a signed artifact with no hand-made tag: release-please opens the release PR, and merging it cuts the tag.

sections.h: The commit prefix and path decide the version bump

blocks.text: A `feat:` commit bumps the minor version and a `fix:` the patch. A commit counts only toward the components whose registered path it changes.
A component whose last tag is further back than 200 commits on main is not seen. `commit-search-depth` in release-please-config.json sets the window.

sections.h: What to check when a release is stuck

blocks.text: Start from the last thing that exists: no release PR, a release PR that will not merge, or a tag without its assets.

sections.h: Each release ships a tarball, a checksum file, and a signature

blocks.text: The artifacts job builds one tarball per component on a macOS arm64 runner, then writes checksums.txt and its cosign bundle.

sections.h: Two commands prove a release is genuine

blocks.text: Check the cosign bundle against checksums.txt first, then the tarball against its line in checksums.txt.
